definitionEn: steadfast in allegiance or duty to a person, group, or cause
usageExplanationZh: 常搭配 loyal to，如 loyal to a friend／a country；也可修飾 customer、supporter 等名詞。
exampleEn: She remained loyal to her friends even during hard times.
exampleZh: 即使在困難時期，她對朋友依然忠誠。
collocations: [{"text":"loyal to","meaningZh":"忠於……"},{"text":"a loyal customer","meaningZh":"忠實顧客"}]

definitionEn: expressed clearly and easy to understand
definitionZh: 清晰易懂的；條理分明的
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 explanation、writing 或 argument；也可形容人在神智清醒、思路清楚的狀態，如 a lucid moment。
exampleEn: His lucid explanation made the complex topic easy to follow.
exampleZh: 他清晰的解說讓這個複雜的主題變得容易理解。
collocations: [{"text":"a lucid explanation","meaningZh":"清楚的解釋"},{"text":"lucid prose","meaningZh":"條理清晰的文章"}]

definitionEn: producing a sizeable profit
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 business、deal、career 等；強調金錢上的利益，語氣偏正式。
exampleEn: They signed a lucrative contract with the software company.
exampleZh: 他們與這家軟體公司簽下一份獲利豐厚的合約。
collocations: [{"text":"a lucrative business","meaningZh":"賺錢的生意"},{"text":"a lucrative contract","meaningZh":"利潤豐厚的合約"}]

definitionEn: so obviously absurd as to be laughable
usageExplanationZh: 語氣比 ridiculous 更強烈，常用於 It's ludicrous that...句型，帶有不可置信的語氣。
exampleEn: It's ludicrous to think we could finish the project in one day.
exampleZh: 認為我們能在一天內完成這個專案，簡直荒謬。
collocations: [{"text":"a ludicrous suggestion","meaningZh":"荒謬的建議"},{"text":"utterly ludicrous","meaningZh":"完全荒唐可笑"}]

definitionEn: only moderately warm
usageExplanationZh: 常形容飲料、食物或水的溫度，如 lukewarm coffee，意指不夠熱也不冰。
exampleEn: He complained that the soup was only lukewarm.
exampleZh: 他抱怨這碗湯只是微溫的。

definitionEn: showing little enthusiasm or interest
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a lukewarm response／reception，形容態度不積極也不反對，介於支持與反對之間。
exampleEn: The proposal received a lukewarm response from the committee.
exampleZh: 這項提案得到委員會不冷不熱的回應。
collocations: [{"text":"a lukewarm response","meaningZh":"冷淡的回應"},{"text":"a lukewarm reception","meaningZh":"不熱烈的接待"}]

definitionEn: a temporary period of quiet or reduced activity
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a lull in the conversation／fighting，指原本活躍的狀態暫時停歇。
exampleEn: There was a brief lull in the storm before it intensified again.
exampleZh: 暴風雨曾有短暫的平息，隨後又再度增強。
collocations: [{"text":"a lull in the conversation","meaningZh":"談話中的短暫沉默"},{"text":"a lull in the fighting","meaningZh":"戰鬥的暫時平息"}]

definitionEn: to calm someone, often by deception, into complacency or sleep
definitionZh: 哄騙使安心；使放鬆戒心
usageExplanationZh: 常見 lull someone into a false sense of security，帶有欺騙、麻痺對方警覺的意味。
exampleEn: The steady rocking lulled the baby to sleep.
exampleZh: 規律的搖晃哄得寶寶睡著了。
collocations: [{"text":"lull someone into a false sense of security","meaningZh":"使某人產生虛假的安全感"}]

definitionEn: to put different things together into one group without distinguishing them
definitionZh: 把…混為一談；歸併在一起
usageExplanationZh: 常用 lump together，帶有草率、不加區分的意味，可能是中性或帶批評語氣。
exampleEn: The report lumps all small businesses together regardless of their size.
exampleZh: 這份報告不分規模，把所有小型企業都混為一談。
collocations: [{"text":"lump together","meaningZh":"混為一談"},{"text":"lump someone in with","meaningZh":"把某人與……歸為同類"}]

definitionEn: a person regarded as extremely foolish or reckless
usageExplanationZh: 口語用法，常帶強烈負面或誇張語氣，形容行為極度荒唐或危險的人。
exampleEn: Only a lunatic would drive that fast in the snow.
exampleZh: 只有瘋子才會在雪地裡開這麼快。
collocations: [{"text":"drive like a lunatic","meaningZh":"像瘋子般開車"}]

definitionEn: extremely foolish or reckless
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 idea、scheme 等，語氣誇張，表示極不合理或危險。
exampleEn: They came up with a lunatic scheme to cross the desert on foot.
exampleZh: 他們想出了一個瘋狂的計畫，要徒步穿越沙漠。

definitionEn: either of the two organs in the chest used for breathing
usageExplanationZh: 常見複數 lungs，用於呼吸系統相關語境，如 lung cancer、lung capacity。
exampleEn: Smoking can seriously damage your lungs.
exampleZh: 抽菸會嚴重傷害你的肺。
collocations: [{"text":"lung cancer","meaningZh":"肺癌"},{"text":"at the top of your lungs","meaningZh":"扯開嗓門地"}]

definitionEn: shockingly vivid or sensational, especially in describing something disturbing
definitionZh: 聳人聽聞的；血腥渲染的
usageExplanationZh: 常見 lurid details／headlines，形容媒體或敘述誇張渲染暴力、犯罪等細節。
exampleEn: The newspaper published lurid details of the crime scene.
exampleZh: 這家報紙刊登了案發現場聳人聽聞的細節。
collocations: [{"text":"lurid details","meaningZh":"聳人聽聞的細節"},{"text":"lurid headlines","meaningZh":"煽情的標題"}]

definitionEn: extremely pleasing to taste or the senses
definitionZh: 甘美多汁的；誘人可口的
usageExplanationZh: 常形容水果、甜點等食物，強調味道濃郁、令人垂涎。
exampleEn: The pie was filled with luscious, ripe strawberries.
exampleZh: 這個派裡裝滿了甘美多汁的成熟草莓。
collocations: [{"text":"luscious fruit","meaningZh":"甘美多汁的水果"},{"text":"a luscious dessert","meaningZh":"誘人可口的甜點"}]

definitionEn: characterized by luxury and great comfort
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 hotel、lifestyle、fabric 等，強調高級舒適，帶正面評價語氣。
exampleEn: They stayed in a luxurious suite overlooking the beach.
exampleZh: 他們住在一間可俯瞰海灘的豪華套房。
collocations: [{"text":"a luxurious hotel","meaningZh":"豪華飯店"},{"text":"luxurious surroundings","meaningZh":"奢華的環境"}]

definitionEn: a state of great comfort or elegance, especially one that is not necessary
usageExplanationZh: 可數或不可數，常見 live in luxury、a luxury item，強調非必需卻令人愉悅的享受。
exampleEn: Owning a car was once considered a luxury in that country.
exampleZh: 在那個國家，擁有一輛車曾經被視為一種奢侈。
collocations: [{"text":"live in luxury","meaningZh":"過奢華生活"},{"text":"a luxury item","meaningZh":"奢侈品"}]

definitionEn: to kill someone, especially by hanging, without a legal trial as an act of mob violence
definitionZh: 私刑處死（尤指未經審判由暴民動用私刑）
usageExplanationZh: 通常指群眾未經司法程序即施以私刑致死，帶有強烈的歷史與社會批判意味。
exampleEn: The mob threatened to lynch the accused man before police intervened.
exampleZh: 暴民威脅要對這名被控告的男子動用私刑，直到警方介入。
collocations: [{"text":"a lynch mob","meaningZh":"私刑暴民"},{"text":"lynch an innocent man","meaningZh":"對無辜男子施以私刑處死"}]

definitionEn: the words of a song
usageExplanationZh: 常用複數 lyrics，指歌曲的文字部分，與旋律 melody 相對。
exampleEn: She wrote the lyrics for the band's new single.
exampleZh: 她為樂團的新單曲寫了歌詞。

definitionEn: expressing personal emotion in a songlike or poetic way
usageExplanationZh: 常見 lyric poetry／poem，強調表達個人情感、風格優美的詩歌。
exampleEn: The poet is known for his lyric verses about nature.
exampleZh: 這位詩人以描寫自然的抒情詩聞名。
collocations: [{"text":"lyric poetry","meaningZh":"抒情詩"},{"text":"a lyric soprano","meaningZh":"抒情女高音"}]

definitionEn: disturbing because concerned with death or violence
definitionZh: 以死亡或暴力為主題的；令人毛骨悚然的
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 tale、humor、scene 等，帶有詭異、令人不安的氣氛。
exampleEn: The museum's macabre exhibit featured tools used in medieval executions.
exampleZh: 博物館這個令人毛骨悚然的展覽展出了中世紀處決所用的工具。
collocations: [{"text":"a macabre discovery","meaningZh":"令人毛骨悚然的發現"},{"text":"macabre humour","meaningZh":"涉及死亡的恐怖幽默"}]

definitionEn: having qualities suggestive of magic or producing a wonderful, enchanting effect
usageExplanationZh: 可形容真正的魔法，也可比喻氣氛、經驗美好得不可思議，如 a magical evening。
exampleEn: They spent a magical evening watching the sunset together.
exampleZh: 他們一起看著日落，度過了一個奇幻美好的夜晚。
collocations: [{"text":"magical powers","meaningZh":"魔力"},{"text":"a magical experience","meaningZh":"奇妙迷人的體驗"}]

definitionEn: generous and forgiving, especially toward a rival or someone in a weaker position
definitionZh: 寬宏大量的；慷慨大度的
usageExplanationZh: 常見 magnanimous in victory，指在自己占優勢時仍展現大度，不趁人之危。
exampleEn: The winning team was magnanimous in victory, praising their opponents.
exampleZh: 獲勝的隊伍展現了寬宏大量的風度，稱讚了對手。
collocations: [{"text":"magnanimous in victory","meaningZh":"獲勝後寬宏大量"},{"text":"a magnanimous gesture","meaningZh":"寬厚的舉動"}]

definitionEn: having the properties of a magnet, or relating to magnetism
usageExplanationZh: 常見 magnetic field、magnetic force，屬物理學語境，描述磁鐵或磁場的特性。
exampleEn: The compass needle aligns with the Earth's magnetic field.
exampleZh: 指南針的指針會與地球的磁場對齊。

definitionEn: having a compelling and attractive quality that draws people in
usageExplanationZh: 常見 magnetic personality／presence，比喻某人具有強烈吸引他人注意與喜愛的特質。
exampleEn: The speaker had a magnetic presence that captivated the audience.
exampleZh: 這位講者具有令人著迷的魅力，深深吸引了觀眾。

definitionEn: extremely beautiful, elaborate, or impressive
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 building、view、performance 等，語氣強烈，表達由衷讚嘆。
exampleEn: The palace offers a magnificent view of the entire valley.
exampleZh: 這座宮殿可以俯瞰整個山谷的壯麗景色。
collocations: [{"text":"a magnificent view","meaningZh":"壯麗景色"},{"text":"a magnificent achievement","meaningZh":"卓越成就"}]

definitionEn: to make something appear larger than it is, or to increase its importance or effect
usageExplanationZh: 常接 image、problem 等；magnify a lens 用於實際放大影像，magnify a problem 則是誇大或加重其嚴重性。
exampleEn: A microscope can magnify a cell thousands of times.
exampleZh: 顯微鏡能將細胞放大數千倍。
collocations: [{"text":"magnify an image","meaningZh":"放大影像"},{"text":"magnify a problem","meaningZh":"誇大問題"}]

definitionEn: the great size, extent, or importance of something
usageExplanationZh: 常見 the magnitude of a problem／disaster，強調事件規模或影響之大，語氣正式。
exampleEn: No one had anticipated the magnitude of the economic crisis.
exampleZh: 沒有人預料到這場經濟危機的規模會如此巨大。
collocations: [{"text":"the magnitude of the task","meaningZh":"任務的艱鉅程度"}]

definitionEn: a female servant employed to do housework
usageExplanationZh: 常見於 hotel maid、housemaid，指受雇從事家務或清潔工作的女性。
exampleEn: A maid comes twice a week to clean the house.
exampleZh: 一名女傭每週來打掃房子兩次。

definitionEn: the process of keeping something in good working condition
usageExplanationZh: 常見 routine maintenance、maintenance costs，用於機械、建築或系統的例行保養與維修。
exampleEn: Regular maintenance can extend the lifespan of the equipment.
exampleZh: 定期保養可以延長這項設備的使用壽命。

definitionEn: financial support provided to a person, especially a former spouse or child
usageExplanationZh: 法律用語，常見於離婚後對配偶或子女的定期經濟支持，如 child maintenance。
exampleEn: He is required to pay monthly maintenance to his ex-wife.
exampleZh: 他必須每月支付贍養費給前妻。

definitionEn: a title used to address or refer to a king or queen
usageExplanationZh: 通常大寫為 Majesty，前面加 His／Her／Your，用於正式稱呼君主。
exampleEn: Her Majesty the Queen will address the nation tonight.
exampleZh: 女王陛下今晚將對全國發表演說。

definitionEn: impressive beauty, dignity, or grandeur
usageExplanationZh: 常見 the majesty of the mountains，形容景色或場面帶來的震撼與敬畏感。
exampleEn: Visitors are awed by the majesty of the ancient cathedral.
exampleZh: 遊客們對這座古老大教堂的莊嚴壯麗讚嘆不已。
collocations: [{"text":"the majesty of the mountains","meaningZh":"群山的雄偉"}]

definitionEn: cosmetics applied to the face
usageExplanationZh: 常見 wear makeup、put on makeup，指用於臉部的化妝用品或化妝後的樣貌。
exampleEn: She rarely wears makeup except for special occasions.
exampleZh: 除了特殊場合，她很少化妝。

definitionEn: the way in which something is composed or the combination of qualities that form a character
usageExplanationZh: 常見 the makeup of a team／personality，指構成整體的成分或個人性格的組合。
exampleEn: The genetic makeup of the two species is remarkably similar.
exampleZh: 這兩個物種的基因組成極為相似。

definitionEn: having or showing a wish to do harm to others
definitionZh: 懷有惡意的；心懷不軌的
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 look、intent、force 等，語氣正式，強調蓄意的惡意，與單純 unkind 不同。
exampleEn: The novel's villain has a malevolent desire to see others suffer.
exampleZh: 這部小說裡的反派懷有讓別人受苦的惡毒念頭。

definitionEn: a failure to function normally
usageExplanationZh: 常見 equipment malfunction、a mechanical malfunction，多用於機械、電子系統等技術性語境。
exampleEn: The crash was caused by a malfunction in the aircraft's software.
exampleZh: 這起墜機事件是由飛機軟體故障所引起的。

definitionEn: to fail to function correctly
usageExplanationZh: 及物或不及物皆可，主詞通常是機器或系統，如 The engine malfunctioned。
exampleEn: The heating system malfunctioned during the coldest week of winter.
exampleZh: 暖氣系統在冬天最冷的那一週發生了故障。

definitionEn: a large building or complex of shops, often with restaurants and parking
usageExplanationZh: 常見 shopping mall，泛指集合眾多商店的大型建築或園區。
exampleEn: Teenagers often hang out at the mall on weekends.
exampleZh: 青少年週末經常聚在購物中心閒逛。

definitionEn: capable of being shaped, bent, or hammered into different forms without breaking
usageExplanationZh: 常形容金屬，如 gold is highly malleable，強調材質可被加工塑形而不斷裂。
exampleEn: Gold is one of the most malleable metals known.
exampleZh: 黃金是已知延展性最佳的金屬之一。

definitionEn: easily influenced or shaped, especially in character or opinion
usageExplanationZh: 常形容 young minds、public opinion 等，比喻性格或想法容易被他人塑造改變。
exampleEn: Young children are especially malleable and learn quickly from their surroundings.
exampleZh: 幼童特別容易受影響，也很快就能從周遭環境中學習。
collocations: [{"text":"malleable young minds","meaningZh":"易受塑造的年輕心靈"}]

definitionEn: a warm-blooded animal that has hair or fur and typically feeds its young with milk
usageExplanationZh: 生物學基本分類詞彙，常見於自然科學文章，如 humans are mammals。
exampleEn: Whales are mammals, even though they live entirely in water.
exampleZh: 鯨魚是哺乳動物，儘管牠們完全生活在水中。

definitionEn: an official instruction or order from an authority
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a legal mandate、a government mandate，指具約束力的正式命令或規定。
exampleEn: The company issued a mandate requiring all staff to wear identification badges.
exampleZh: 公司發布了一項規定，要求所有員工佩戴識別證。

definitionEn: the authority given to an elected government or leader by voters
usageExplanationZh: 常見 win a mandate，指選舉勝利後獲得推行政策的正當性與民意支持。
exampleEn: The president claimed a mandate for sweeping economic reforms.
exampleZh: 總統聲稱自己獲得了推動全面經濟改革的民意授權。

definitionEn: required by law or a rule; compulsory
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mandatory attendance、mandatory retirement，強調規定上沒有選擇餘地，與 optional 相對。
exampleEn: Wearing a seatbelt is mandatory in most countries.
exampleZh: 在大多數國家，繫安全帶是強制規定。

definitionEn: to show a quality or feeling clearly through actions or appearance
usageExplanationZh: 常見 manifest itself as、symptoms manifest，強調原本隱藏的特質或狀態變得明顯可見。
exampleEn: Her anxiety manifested itself as constant restlessness.
exampleZh: 她的焦慮表現為持續不安。

definitionEn: an official list of a ship or aircraft's cargo or passengers
usageExplanationZh: 運輸與貿易用語，常見 a cargo manifest／passenger manifest，用於記錄運送內容或人員名單。
exampleEn: Customs officials checked the ship's manifest before allowing it to dock.
exampleZh: 海關人員在允許這艘船靠岸前，先檢查了它的載貨單。

definitionEn: a visible or perceptible sign that something exists or is happening
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a manifestation of，指某種情緒、狀態或問題以具體方式呈現出來。
exampleEn: The rash was a manifestation of an underlying allergy.
exampleZh: 這個疹子是潛在過敏反應的一種表現。

definitionEn: to control or influence someone unfairly or deviously for one's own advantage
usageExplanationZh: 常帶負面意涵，指以不正當手段影響他人想法或行為，如 manipulate public opinion。
exampleEn: The politician was accused of manipulating the media to boost his image.
exampleZh: 這名政治人物被指控操縱媒體以提升自己的形象。

definitionEn: to handle or operate something skillfully, especially with the hands
usageExplanationZh: 中性用法，常見於機械、工具或數據，如 manipulate the controls、manipulate data。
exampleEn: The surgeon carefully manipulated the instrument during the procedure.
exampleZh: 外科醫生在手術過程中小心地操作這件器械。

definitionEn: skilled at influencing or controlling people in an unfair or dishonest way
definitionZh: 善於操縱人的；工於心計的
usageExplanationZh: 帶負面評價，形容人慣於利用手段操控他人以謀取私利。
exampleEn: He has a manipulative side that makes it hard to trust him.
exampleZh: 他有工於心計的一面，讓人很難信任他。

definitionEn: a large, impressive house
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a country mansion，強調房屋規模宏大、氣派十足，暗示屋主富裕。
exampleEn: The billionaire owns a mansion with over thirty rooms.
exampleZh: 這位億萬富翁擁有一棟超過三十個房間的豪宅。

definitionEn: a book of instructions, especially for a machine or process
usageExplanationZh: 常見 an instruction manual、a user manual，指說明如何操作或使用某物的書面資料。
exampleEn: Please refer to the manual before assembling the furniture.
exampleZh: 組裝家具前請先參閱說明手冊。

definitionEn: done with the hands or by physical effort rather than by machine
usageExplanationZh: 常見 manual labor、manual transmission，強調以人力或雙手進行，而非自動化或機械操作。
exampleEn: The factory replaced most manual tasks with automated machines.
exampleZh: 這家工廠已將大部分的手工作業改由自動化機器取代。

definitionEn: to make goods in large quantities, usually with machinery
usageExplanationZh: 常見 manufacture products／goods，多指工業化大量生產，主詞通常是公司或工廠。
exampleEn: The company manufactures electronic components for smartphones.
exampleZh: 這家公司為智慧型手機製造電子零件。

definitionEn: animal or plant waste used to fertilize soil
usageExplanationZh: 農業用語，常見 spread manure，指施用於土壤以增進養分的有機肥料。
exampleEn: The farmer spread manure over the field before planting.
exampleZh: 農夫在播種前先在田裡施了肥料。

definitionEn: a handwritten or typed document, especially one submitted for publication
usageExplanationZh: 常見 submit a manuscript to a publisher，指作者交付出版社審查前的原始文稿。
exampleEn: She spent five years writing the manuscript for her first novel.
exampleZh: 她花了五年時間寫出第一部小說的原稿。

definitionEn: a tree known for its distinctive leaves and, in some species, sap used to make syrup
usageExplanationZh: 常見 maple syrup（楓糖漿）、maple leaf（楓葉），與加拿大文化意象密切相關。
exampleEn: Maple syrup is made by boiling down the sap of maple trees.
exampleZh: 楓糖漿是將楓樹的樹液煮沸濃縮而成的。

definitionEn: a hard rock, often veined, used for sculpture and building
usageExplanationZh: 常見 marble floor／statue，強調其光滑質感與高級建材形象。
exampleEn: The lobby floor was made of polished white marble.
exampleZh: 大廳的地板是用打磨過的白色大理石鋪成的。

definitionEn: a small ball, usually of glass, used in children's games
usageExplanationZh: 常見 play marbles，指用彈珠進行的傳統童玩遊戲。
exampleEn: The children knelt on the ground playing marbles.
exampleZh: 孩子們跪在地上玩彈珠。

definitionEn: the blank space around the edge of a printed or written page
usageExplanationZh: 常見 write in the margin，指頁面文字周圍的空白部分。
exampleEn: She scribbled notes in the margin of the textbook.
exampleZh: 她在課本的頁邊空白處寫下了筆記。

definitionEn: an amount by which something exceeds or falls short of a given level; a degree of difference
usageExplanationZh: 常見 win by a narrow margin、profit margin，強調數量或程度上的差距或空間。
exampleEn: The team won the game by a narrow margin.
exampleZh: 這支隊伍以些微差距贏得了比賽。

definitionEn: relating to the sea
usageExplanationZh: 常見 marine life、marine biology，泛指與海洋、海中生物相關的事物。
exampleEn: Marine biologists study the creatures that live in the ocean.
exampleZh: 海洋生物學家研究生活在海洋中的生物。

definitionEn: a soldier trained to serve on land and at sea, especially in the Marine Corps
usageExplanationZh: 常大寫 Marine，特指海軍陸戰隊的成員，強調兩棲作戰訓練。
exampleEn: He served as a Marine for eight years before retiring.
exampleZh: 他在退伍前擔任了八年的海軍陸戰隊隊員。

definitionEn: relating to marriage
usageExplanationZh: 常見 marital status（婚姻狀態）、marital problems，正式用語，多見於法律或表格文件。
exampleEn: Please indicate your marital status on the form.
exampleZh: 請在表格上註明你的婚姻狀態。

definitionEn: to leave someone stranded in an isolated place with little hope of escape
definitionZh: 使孤立無援；棄置（於孤島等處）
usageExplanationZh: 常見 be marooned on an island，強調被迫困於無法離開的環境。
exampleEn: The sailors were marooned on a deserted island after the shipwreck.
exampleZh: 船難後，這些水手被困在一座荒島上，無法離開。
collocations: [{"text":"be marooned on an island","meaningZh":"受困於島上"}]

definitionEn: a dark brownish-red color
usageExplanationZh: 描述顏色，介於紅與棕之間的深色調，常用於服裝或裝潢描述，可作名詞指這個顏色本身。
exampleEn: The walls were painted a deep maroon.
exampleZh: 牆壁被漆成了深褐紫紅色。
collocations: [{"text":"a deep shade of maroon","meaningZh":"深褐紅色調"}]

definitionEn: an area of low, wet land, often with grassy vegetation
usageExplanationZh: 常見 salt marsh、marshland，指介於陸地與水域之間的濕地生態系統。
exampleEn: The birds nest in the marsh near the river.
exampleZh: 這些鳥類在河邊的沼澤地築巢。

definitionEn: to organize or arrange people or things carefully, especially in preparation for something
definitionZh: 整頓；調集；有條理地安排
usageExplanationZh: 常見 marshal one's arguments／resources，強調有系統地集結或整理，以備使用。
exampleEn: She carefully marshaled her arguments before the debate.
exampleZh: 她在辯論前仔細整理了自己的論點。

definitionEn: an official responsible for enforcing court orders or organizing public events
usageExplanationZh: 常見 U.S. Marshal、fire marshal，依語境不同指不同類型的公務或治安人員。
exampleEn: The fire marshal inspected the building for safety violations.
exampleZh: 消防長官檢查了這棟建築物是否有安全違規之處。

definitionEn: a person who suffers or is killed for their beliefs or principles
usageExplanationZh: 常見宗教或政治語境，如 die a martyr，強調為信仰或理念犧牲。
exampleEn: The soldier is remembered as a martyr who died defending his country.
exampleZh: 這名士兵被人們紀念為捍衛國家而犧牲的烈士。
collocations: [{"text":"a martyr for the cause","meaningZh":"為理念犧牲的烈士"}]

definitionEn: to kill someone because of their beliefs, or to make them suffer greatly for a cause
usageExplanationZh: 常見被動語態 be martyred，強調因信仰或理念而被迫害致死或受苦。
exampleEn: Thousands were martyred during the religious persecutions.
exampleZh: 數以千計的人在這場宗教迫害中殉道而死。
collocations: [{"text":"be martyred for one's beliefs","meaningZh":"因信仰而殉道"}]

definitionEn: a covering worn over the face to disguise, protect, or conceal identity
usageExplanationZh: 常見 wear a mask，依語境可指防護用口罩或化裝用面具。
exampleEn: Surgeons wear a mask to prevent contamination during operations.
exampleZh: 外科醫生手術時戴口罩以防止感染。

definitionEn: to hide or disguise a feeling, quality, or problem
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mask one's feelings／mask a smell，指刻意隱藏真實情緒、氣味或問題。
exampleEn: He tried to mask his disappointment with a smile.
exampleZh: 他試圖用微笑掩飾自己的失望。

definitionEn: a false show or pretense of being something one is not
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a masquerade of，比喻表面掩飾真實身分或意圖的行為。
exampleEn: Their friendly smiles were just a masquerade for their true intentions.
exampleZh: 他們友善的笑容只是掩飾真實意圖的偽裝。

definitionEn: to pretend to be someone or something one is not
usageExplanationZh: 常見 masquerade as，強調刻意冒充另一種身分以達到欺騙目的。
exampleEn: The scammer masqueraded as a bank employee to steal information.
exampleZh: 這名詐騙犯偽裝成銀行員工以竊取資訊。

definitionEn: the quantity of matter in an object, related to its weight
usageExplanationZh: 物理學用語，與 weight（重量）不同，指物體所含物質的量，不受重力影響。
exampleEn: The mass of the object remains constant regardless of location.
exampleZh: 這個物體的質量無論在哪裡都保持不變。

definitionEn: a large quantity or number of something
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a mass of people／data，泛指數量龐大的人或物，語氣中性。
exampleEn: A mass of protesters gathered outside the parliament building.
exampleZh: 大批抗議民眾聚集在國會大樓外。

definitionEn: to kill a large number of people in a brutal and indiscriminate way
usageExplanationZh: 語氣強烈，強調大規模且不分對象的殺戮，常見於戰爭或種族衝突的敘述。
exampleEn: Soldiers massacred hundreds of unarmed civilians in the village.
exampleZh: 士兵在這座村莊屠殺了數百名手無寸鐵的平民。

definitionEn: extremely large in size, amount, or degree
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 building、amount、attack 等，語氣比 big 更強烈，強調規模驚人。
exampleEn: The company suffered a massive loss after the market crash.
exampleZh: 這家公司在市場崩盤後蒙受了巨大的損失。

definitionEn: a breeding partner of an animal, or an informal term for a friend
definitionZh: 配偶；夥伴；朋友（英式口語）
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a mate for life（終身伴侶），也可指動物的交配對象；英式英語中常泛指朋友。
exampleEn: Wolves usually stay with the same mate for life.
exampleZh: 狼通常終身與同一隻配偶相伴。
collocations: [{"text":"find a mate","meaningZh":"找到配偶"},{"text":"an old mate","meaningZh":"老朋友"}]

definitionEn: an officer on a commercial ship who ranks below the captain
usageExplanationZh: 航海用語，如 first mate，指商船上僅次於船長的職務。
exampleEn: The first mate took over navigation while the captain rested.
exampleZh: 船長休息時，大副接手負責航行。

definitionEn: to become real, actual, or apparent; to happen as expected
usageExplanationZh: 常見 fail to materialize，指原本預期或計畫的事情最終並未發生或成真。
exampleEn: Despite months of planning, the merger never materialized.
exampleZh: 儘管籌劃了好幾個月，這樁併購案最終並未成真。

definitionEn: an environment or material in which something develops, or a rectangular array of numbers
usageExplanationZh: 一般用法指孕育、產生某事物的環境或背景；數學用法則指由數字排列成的矩形陣列。
exampleEn: The city's diverse culture provided a rich matrix for artistic innovation.
exampleZh: 這座城市多元的文化為藝術創新提供了豐富的孕育環境。
collocations: [{"text":"a social matrix","meaningZh":"社會環境母體"},{"text":"a matrix of numbers","meaningZh":"數字矩陣"}]

definitionEn: a large, thick pad used as or on a bed for sleeping
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a firm／soft mattress，描述床墊的軟硬度，日常生活常用詞彙。
exampleEn: They bought a new mattress to help with his back pain.
exampleZh: 他們買了一張新床墊來緩解他的背痛。

definitionEn: fully developed, either physically or emotionally
usageExplanationZh: 可形容人的心智發展，也可形容植物、動物等生理上的成熟，與 immature 相對。
exampleEn: She has always been mature for her age.
exampleZh: 她一直都比同齡人更成熟。

definitionEn: to develop fully, or to become due for payment
definitionZh: 成熟；發展成熟；（債券等）到期
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mature over time；金融語境中 the bond matures 指債券到達應償還的期限。
exampleEn: The bond will mature in ten years.
exampleZh: 這張債券將在十年後到期。
collocations: [{"text":"mature into an adult","meaningZh":"發育成為成體"},{"text":"bonds mature","meaningZh":"債券到期"}]

definitionEn: the state of being fully developed, or the date a financial obligation becomes due
usageExplanationZh: 可指心智或生理的成熟狀態，也可指金融工具到期償付的時間點。
exampleEn: The certificate of deposit reaches maturity in two years.
exampleZh: 這張定期存單將在兩年後到期。
collocations: [{"text":"emotional maturity","meaningZh":"情緒成熟度"},{"text":"reach maturity","meaningZh":"達到成熟期"}]

definitionEn: a pale purple color
usageExplanationZh: 描述介於粉紫與灰紫之間的色調，常用於時尚、室內設計描述。
exampleEn: The walls were painted a soft mauve.
exampleZh: 牆壁被漆成柔和的淡紫色。
collocations: [{"text":"a shade of mauve","meaningZh":"一種淡紫色調"}]

definitionEn: of a pale purple color
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 dress、wall 等名詞，用來形容物品的顏色。
exampleEn: She wore a mauve dress to the wedding.
exampleZh: 她穿了一件淡紫色的洋裝去參加婚禮。

definitionEn: to make something as great or as large as possible
usageExplanationZh: 常見 maximize profits／efficiency，強調在既有條件下追求最大成效。
exampleEn: The company redesigned its website to maximize user engagement.
exampleZh: 這家公司重新設計了網站，以最大化使用者的參與度。

definitionEn: the greatest possible amount or degree
usageExplanationZh: 常見 at maximum capacity、reach a maximum，與 minimum 相對，指上限或極大值。
exampleEn: The elevator has a maximum capacity of ten people.
exampleZh: 這台電梯的最大容納人數是十人。

definitionEn: a field of grass, especially one used for grazing or hay
usageExplanationZh: 常見於鄉村景色描述，如 a green meadow，指自然生長草類的開闊土地。
exampleEn: Cows grazed peacefully in the meadow.
exampleZh: 牛群在草地上安靜地吃草。

definitionEn: lacking in quantity or quality; scant
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 income、meal、resources 等，強調數量或品質嚴重不足。
exampleEn: They survived on a meager diet of rice and beans.
exampleZh: 他們靠著米飯和豆子這種微薄的飲食勉強維生。

definitionEn: having a serious, useful, or important quality or purpose
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a meaningful relationship／conversation，強調具有深度或實質價值，而非表面形式。
exampleEn: She wanted a career that felt meaningful, not just profitable.
exampleZh: 她想要一份感覺有意義的工作，而不只是賺錢的工作。

definitionEn: relating to machines, or done automatically without much thought
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a mechanical failure（機械故障）；也可比喻性地形容動作呆板、缺乏情感，如 a mechanical response。
exampleEn: The delay was caused by a mechanical failure in the engine.
exampleZh: 這次延誤是由引擎的機械故障造成的。
collocations: [{"text":"mechanical engineering","meaningZh":"機械工程"},{"text":"a mechanical response","meaningZh":"機械式的回應"}]

definitionEn: a system of parts working together, or a process by which something is achieved
usageExplanationZh: 可指實體機械裝置，也可比喻抽象的運作方式，如 a mechanism for resolving disputes。
exampleEn: The government created a new mechanism for resolving trade disputes.
exampleZh: 政府建立了一套解決貿易爭端的新機制。
collocations: [{"text":"a coping mechanism","meaningZh":"因應機制"},{"text":"a locking mechanism","meaningZh":"鎖定裝置"}]

definitionEn: a small metal disk awarded for an achievement, especially in sports or the military
usageExplanationZh: 常見 win a gold medal，用於表彰體育競賽、軍事功績等傑出表現。
exampleEn: She won a gold medal in the swimming competition.
exampleZh: 她在游泳比賽中贏得了金牌。

definitionEn: to try to help two opposing sides reach an agreement
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mediate a dispute／conflict，強調第三方介入協助雙方達成共識，語氣中立。
exampleEn: A neutral party was brought in to mediate the labor dispute.
exampleZh: 一位中立人士被請來調解這場勞資糾紛。
collocations: [{"text":"mediate between two sides","meaningZh":"在雙方之間調解"}]

definitionEn: relating to the Middle Ages, roughly from the 5th to the 15th century
usageExplanationZh: 常見 medieval castle／history，也可比喻性地帶貶意形容過時的作法，如 medieval attitudes。
exampleEn: The town still has several well-preserved medieval buildings.
exampleZh: 這座小鎮仍保留了幾棟保存良好的中世紀建築。

definitionEn: to focus one's mind for a period of time in silence, often for relaxation or spiritual purposes
usageExplanationZh: 常見 meditate on／about something，指集中精神深思或修習靜坐，帶宗教或身心放鬆意涵。
exampleEn: He meditates for twenty minutes every morning before work.
exampleZh: 他每天早上工作前都會靜坐冥想二十分鐘。
collocations: [{"text":"meditate on a question","meaningZh":"靜思一個問題"}]

definitionEn: the practice of focusing the mind in silence, or deep, continuous reflection on a subject
usageExplanationZh: 常見 practice meditation，也可指對某主題深入而持續的思考，語氣較正式。
exampleEn: Daily meditation has helped reduce her stress levels.
exampleZh: 每天冥想有助於降低她的壓力程度。

definitionEn: quiet, gentle, and easily giving in to others rather than asserting oneself
usageExplanationZh: 常帶輕微負面語氣，暗示過度順從、缺乏主見，與 assertive 相對。
exampleEn: He was too meek to complain about the unfair treatment.
exampleZh: 他太過溫順，不敢對這種不公平的待遇提出抗議。

definitionEn: a feeling of deep, thoughtful sadness
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a sense of melancholy，強調帶有詩意、沉思意味的淡淡哀愁，而非強烈痛苦。
exampleEn: A quiet melancholy settled over her as she read the old letters.
exampleZh: 讀著這些舊信，一股靜靜的憂鬱籠罩了她。

definitionEn: expressing or causing a feeling of thoughtful sadness
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 song、mood、expression 等，語氣帶文學色彩。
exampleEn: The film has a melancholy tone that lingers long after it ends.
exampleZh: 這部電影帶有一種憂鬱的基調，看完後仍久久縈繞心頭。

definitionEn: to blend or combine different things smoothly
usageExplanationZh: 常見 meld together，強調不同元素自然結合成一體，語氣較正式或文學化。
exampleEn: The chef melded traditional and modern flavors in the dish.
exampleZh: 這位主廚將傳統與現代的風味融合在這道菜裡。

definitionEn: a sequence of musical notes that is pleasing to hear; a tune
usageExplanationZh: 音樂用語，常見 a beautiful melody，指歌曲或樂曲中主要且易記的音符線條。
exampleEn: The song's melody stayed in my head all day.
exampleZh: 這首歌的旋律讓我一整天都揮之不去。

definitionEn: a thin, flexible layer of tissue that covers or lines an organ or structure
usageExplanationZh: 生物學常見，如 cell membrane（細胞膜），指包覆或分隔生物結構的薄層組織。
exampleEn: Oxygen passes through the membrane of the lung's air sacs.
exampleZh: 氧氣會通過肺部氣囊的薄膜進行交換。

definitionEn: a short written message, typically used within an organization
usageExplanationZh: 常見於辦公室語境，如 send a memo to staff，指簡短的內部通知或提醒。
exampleEn: The manager sent a memo reminding staff of the new policy.
exampleZh: 經理發了一份備忘錄，提醒員工注意新政策。

definitionEn: a written account of one's own life or personal experiences
usageExplanationZh: 常見 write a memoir，比自傳（autobiography）更聚焦於特定時期或主題的個人經歷。
exampleEn: The retired general published a memoir about his years in the war.
exampleZh: 這位退役將軍出版了一本關於他從軍歲月的回憶錄。

definitionEn: worth remembering or easily remembered, especially because it is impressive or unusual
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 experience、performance 等，語氣正面，強調印象深刻、令人難以忘懷。
exampleEn: Their wedding was a truly memorable event for everyone involved.
exampleZh: 他們的婚禮對所有參與者來說都是一場真正難忘的盛事。

definitionEn: a formal, often official, written note or record, typically outlining an agreement or policy
usageExplanationZh: 比 memo 更正式，常見於商業或外交文件，如 a memorandum of understanding。
exampleEn: The two countries signed a memorandum of understanding on trade.
exampleZh: 這兩國就貿易議題簽署了一份諒解備忘錄。

definitionEn: a structure or event established to honor and remember a person or event
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a war memorial、a memorial service，用於悼念逝者或紀念重大事件。
exampleEn: A memorial was built to honor the soldiers who died in the war.
exampleZh: 人們建了一座紀念碑，以緬懷在這場戰爭中犧牲的士兵。

definitionEn: given to lying or being untruthful
usageExplanationZh: 正式或文學用語，比 dishonest 語氣更強烈，常形容人的性格或言論慣於欺騙。
exampleEn: The politician was criticized for making mendacious claims during the debate.
exampleZh: 這名政治人物在辯論中因發表不實言論而受到批評。

definitionEn: relating to the mind or the process of thinking
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mental health、mental effort，涵蓋思考、情緒等內在心智層面的活動與狀態。
exampleEn: Regular exercise can improve both physical and mental health.
exampleZh: 規律運動能同時改善生理與心理健康。

definitionEn: a particular way of thinking or a typical attitude that determines behavior
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a victim mentality、a winning mentality，強調某群體或個人特有的思考習慣與態度傾向。
exampleEn: The team needed to adopt a more competitive mentality to succeed.
exampleZh: 這支隊伍需要培養更具競爭意識的心態才能成功。

definitionEn: an experienced and trusted person who guides and advises someone with less experience
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a career mentor，強調長期指導與經驗傳承的關係，多為非正式的師徒關係。
exampleEn: Her mentor helped her navigate the challenges of starting a business.
exampleZh: 她的導師幫助她度過了創業初期的種種挑戰。

definitionEn: a professional soldier hired to fight for a foreign country or group
usageExplanationZh: 軍事用語，強調為金錢而非國家忠誠而戰的職業軍人。
exampleEn: The rebel group hired mercenaries to bolster its forces.
exampleZh: 這個叛亂團體僱用了傭兵來壯大自己的軍力。

definitionEn: motivated primarily by a desire for money rather than other considerations
definitionZh: 唯利是圖的；為錢而做的
usageExplanationZh: 常帶負面評價，形容人做事只看重金錢報酬，缺乏其他動機或原則。
exampleEn: His mercenary attitude toward the job made his colleagues uneasy.
exampleZh: 他對這份工作唯利是圖的態度讓同事們感到不安。

definitionEn: a person who buys and sells goods, especially in large quantities or for profit
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a wine merchant、a merchant ship，泛指從事買賣交易的人或相關行業。
exampleEn: The merchant imported silk and spices from overseas.
exampleZh: 這名商人從海外進口絲綢與香料。

definitionEn: subject to sudden and unpredictable changes in mood or behavior
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 personality、temperament，強調情緒或態度反覆無常，難以預測。
exampleEn: Her mercurial temper made her difficult to work with.
exampleZh: 她喜怒無常的脾氣讓人很難跟她共事。

definitionEn: compassion or forgiveness shown toward someone one has the power to punish
usageExplanationZh: 常見 show mercy、at the mercy of，強調對他人施予寬容而非懲罰的態度。
exampleEn: The judge showed mercy and gave the first-time offender a lighter sentence.
exampleZh: 法官展現了寬容，對這名初犯者從輕量刑。
collocations: [{"text":"show mercy","meaningZh":"施以仁慈"},{"text":"at the mercy of","meaningZh":"任由……擺布"}]

definitionEn: to combine or join two or more things into one
usageExplanationZh: 常見 merge with／into，可指公司合併，也可指車道匯入、資料合併等各種情境。
exampleEn: The two companies merged to form a larger corporation.
exampleZh: 這兩家公司合併成了一家更大的企業。
collocations: [{"text":"merge with another company","meaningZh":"與另一家公司合併"}]

definitionEn: the combination of two or more organizations, especially companies, into one
usageExplanationZh: 商業用語，常見 a merger between two companies，強調正式的整併過程與結果。
exampleEn: The merger created one of the largest banks in the country.
exampleZh: 這次合併造就了該國最大的銀行之一。

definitionEn: a quality or feature that deserves praise or approval
usageExplanationZh: 常見 on its merits（就其本身優劣而論）、the merits of a case，強調客觀上值得肯定之處。
exampleEn: The proposal has considerable merit despite its high cost.
exampleZh: 儘管成本高昂，這項提案仍有相當的價值。

definitionEn: the chemical processes in a living organism that maintain life, especially those converting food into energy
usageExplanationZh: 生物學用語，常見 a fast／slow metabolism，指身體將食物轉化為能量的一系列化學過程。
exampleEn: Regular exercise can help boost your metabolism.
exampleZh: 規律運動有助於提升你的新陳代謝。

definitionEn: a word or phrase used to describe something by referring to something else with similar qualities, without using "like" or "as"
usageExplanationZh: 修辭學用語，與明喻 simile（使用 like／as）不同，強調直接以另一事物比喻本體。
exampleEn: Time is a thief is a common metaphor for how quickly time passes.
exampleZh: 「時間是小偷」是常用來比喻時光飛逝的隱喻。

definitionEn: relating to abstract concepts beyond the physical world, such as existence or reality
definitionZh: 形而上學的；抽象哲理的
usageExplanationZh: 常見於哲學語境，如 metaphysical questions，探討超越物理現象的存在、本質等議題。
exampleEn: Philosophers have long debated metaphysical questions about the nature of reality.
exampleZh: 哲學家長期以來一直在辯論關於現實本質的形而上學問題。

definitionEn: done in a careful, orderly, and systematic way
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 approach、person 等，強調按部就班、注重步驟，與 haphazard 相對。
exampleEn: She took a methodical approach to organizing the files.
exampleZh: 她以有條理的方式整理這些檔案。

definitionEn: a system of methods used in a particular field of study or activity
usageExplanationZh: 常見於學術語境，如 research methodology，指整套用於進行研究或分析的系統性方法。
exampleEn: The study's methodology was criticized for its small sample size.
exampleZh: 這項研究的方法論因樣本數過小而受到批評。

definitionEn: showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise
definitionZh: 一絲不苟的；極為謹慎的
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 planning、attention to detail 等，強調對細節的高度重視，語氣正面。
exampleEn: The report was the result of meticulous research over several years。
exampleZh: 這份報告是經過數年一絲不苟研究的成果。
collocations: [{"text":"meticulous attention to detail","meaningZh":"對細節一絲不苟的關注"}]

definitionEn: relating to a large city or its surrounding area
usageExplanationZh: 常見 metropolitan area，指涵蓋主要城市及其周邊區域的地理或行政範圍。
exampleEn: Traffic congestion is a major issue in most metropolitan areas.
exampleZh: 交通壅塞是大多數都會區的主要問題。

definitionEn: a device that converts sound into an electrical signal, used for recording or amplifying speech and sound
usageExplanationZh: 常見 speak into the microphone，日常與專業用語皆通用。
exampleEn: The singer adjusted the microphone before starting her performance.
exampleZh: 這位歌手在開始表演前調整了麥克風。

definitionEn: too small to be seen without a microscope; extremely small
definitionZh: 微小的；顯微鏡下才可見的
usageExplanationZh: 常見 microscopic organisms／details，強調肉眼無法察覺的極小尺寸。
exampleEn: The water sample contained microscopic organisms invisible to the naked eye.
exampleZh: 這份水樣中含有肉眼看不見的微小生物。

definitionEn: a kitchen appliance that cooks or heats food using electromagnetic waves
usageExplanationZh: 日常生活常用詞，常見 heat something in the microwave，也可指微波本身作為電磁波。
exampleEn: He heated up the leftovers in the microwave.
exampleZh: 他用微波爐把剩菜加熱。
collocations: [{"text":"heat food in the microwave","meaningZh":"用微波爐加熱食物"}]

definitionEn: having or showing great power, strength, or force
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 army、river、blow 等，語氣正式或文學化，強調規模或力量之大。
exampleEn: The mighty river carved a deep canyon over millions of years.
exampleZh: 這條大河歷經數百萬年，切割出了一道深峽谷。

definitionEn: a person who moves from one place to another, especially to find work
usageExplanationZh: 常見 migrant worker，多指因經濟因素而遷移工作地點的人，與 immigrant（永久移居他國者）略有不同。
exampleEn: Many migrant workers travel seasonally to harvest crops.
exampleZh: 許多移居工人會季節性地遷移以採收農作物。

definitionEn: to move from one place to live or work in another, often seasonally or in search of better conditions
usageExplanationZh: 常見於人口或動物語境，如 birds migrate south，指季節性或長距離的移動。
exampleEn: Thousands of birds migrate south for the winter every year.
exampleZh: 每年冬天，成千上萬隻鳥兒會遷徙南方。

definitionEn: the movement of people or animals from one place to another
usageExplanationZh: 常見 bird migration、human migration，泛指大規模、通常是季節性或長期性的移動。
exampleEn: The annual migration of wildebeest across the plains is a famous natural spectacle.
exampleZh: 角馬每年橫越平原的遷徙是著名的自然奇觀。

definitionEn: relating to animals that regularly move from one region to another, especially with the seasons
usageExplanationZh: 常見 migratory birds／species，專用於描述具季節性遷移習性的動物。
exampleEn: Migratory birds travel thousands of miles between breeding grounds.
exampleZh: 候鳥在繁殖地之間遷徙數千英里。

definitionEn: not severe, harsh, or extreme in effect or degree
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mild weather／symptoms／flavor，涵蓋天氣、病情、口味等多種語境，強調程度不強烈。
exampleEn: She experienced only mild symptoms after catching the cold.
exampleZh: 她感冒後只出現輕微的症狀。
collocations: [{"text":"mild symptoms","meaningZh":"輕微症狀"},{"text":"a mild winter","meaningZh":"溫和的冬季"}]

definitionEn: a group of civilians trained to act as soldiers, especially in times of emergency
usageExplanationZh: 區別於正規軍 regular army，強調由平民組成、非常設性的武裝力量。
exampleEn: The local militia was called up to defend the town.
exampleZh: 當地的民兵組織被召集起來保衛這座城鎮。

definitionEn: a building or machine used for grinding grain into flour, or a factory for processing raw materials
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a flour mill、a steel mill，泛指以機械加工原料的場所或設備。
exampleEn: The old mill by the river once ground wheat into flour.
exampleZh: 河邊那座老磨坊過去曾把小麥磨成麵粉。

definitionEn: to move around in a confused or aimless way, especially in a crowd
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mill around，指人群漫無目的地聚集或走動，帶有雜亂無序的感覺。
exampleEn: Fans milled around outside the stadium waiting for the gates to open.
exampleZh: 粉絲們在體育館外雜亂走動，等待大門開啟。

definitionEn: a period of one thousand years
usageExplanationZh: 常見 the new millennium（新千禧年），泛指以一千年為單位的時間跨度。
exampleEn: The monument has stood for nearly a millennium.
exampleZh: 這座紀念碑已矗立了將近一千年。

definitionEn: to act out something using only gestures and movements, without speaking
definitionZh: 以肢體動作表演；比手畫腳表演
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mime an action，強調不使用言語，僅靠肢體或臉部表情傳達意思。
exampleEn: The actor mimed climbing a ladder without any props.
exampleZh: 這名演員沒有使用任何道具，僅以肢體動作表演爬梯子。
collocations: [{"text":"mime opening a door","meaningZh":"以動作表演開門"}]

definitionEn: a performer who acts out a story or scene using only gestures, or such a performance itself
usageExplanationZh: 常見於劇場語境，指以肢體表演為主、不使用台詞的表演藝術或表演者。
exampleEn: The mime entertained the crowd with silent gestures alone.
exampleZh: 這位默劇演員僅用無聲的肢體動作逗樂了群眾。

definitionEn: to cut food, especially meat, into very small pieces
usageExplanationZh: 常見 minced meat（絞肉），多指以刀具或機器將食材切成細碎狀。
exampleEn: She minced the garlic finely before adding it to the pan.
exampleZh: 她把大蒜切得細碎後才放入鍋中。

definitionEn: to speak in an indirect, overly cautious way to avoid offending someone
definitionZh: 說話拐彎抹角；委婉其詞
usageExplanationZh: 常見 not mince words（直言不諱），表示某人說話坦率、不拐彎抹角。
exampleEn: He didn't mince his words when criticizing the plan.
exampleZh: 他在批評這項計畫時毫不拐彎抹角。

definitionEn: an excavation in the ground for extracting minerals, coal, or metal ore
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a coal mine、a gold mine，指開採地下資源的場所。
exampleEn: Hundreds of workers were trapped underground after the mine collapsed.
exampleZh: 礦坑坍塌後，數百名工人受困於地下。

definitionEn: to dig into the ground to extract minerals or resources
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mine coal／gold，也可比喻性地用於挖掘資料，如 mine data。
exampleEn: The company mines copper in several countries.
exampleZh: 這家公司在好幾個國家開採銅礦。

definitionEn: a naturally occurring solid substance with a specific chemical composition, found in rocks or soil
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mineral deposits、mineral water（礦泉水），涵蓋自然界中各種無機固態物質。
exampleEn: The region is rich in mineral deposits, including iron and copper.
exampleZh: 這個地區蘊藏豐富的礦藏，包括鐵礦和銅礦。

definitionEn: to mix or move around and talk with different people, especially at a social event
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mingle with guests，強調社交場合中與不同的人交流互動。
exampleEn: Guests mingled in the garden while waiting for dinner to be served。
exampleZh: 賓客們在等待晚餐上桌時，在花園裡相互交際。

definitionEn: being a very small version of something
usageExplanationZh: 常見 miniature model／version，指按比例縮小的物品，強調尺寸極小。
exampleEn: He built a miniature replica of the Eiffel Tower out of matchsticks.
exampleZh: 他用火柴棒搭建了一座艾菲爾鐵塔的微型複製品。

definitionEn: a very small copy or model of something
usageExplanationZh: 常見於收藏或裝飾語境，指按比例製作的小型複製品。
exampleEn: The museum displays a collection of miniatures depicting historic battles.
exampleZh: 博物館展出了一系列描繪歷史戰役的縮小模型。

definitionEn: of a very small amount, degree, or size; the least possible
usageExplanationZh: 常見 minimal effort／risk，強調數量或程度低到幾乎可以忽略。
exampleEn: The new design requires minimal maintenance.
exampleZh: 這項新設計只需要極少的維護。

definitionEn: to reduce something to the smallest possible amount or degree
usageExplanationZh: 常見 minimize risk／cost，強調主動採取行動以縮減負面因素的規模或影響。
exampleEn: The company took steps to minimize the environmental impact of its factories.
exampleZh: 這家公司採取措施，將其工廠對環境的影響降到最低。

definitionEn: the smallest amount, value, or degree that is possible or required
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a minimum of，也可作形容詞用，如 minimum wage（最低薪資）。
exampleEn: The job requires a minimum of two years' experience.
exampleZh: 這份工作要求至少兩年的工作經驗。
collocations: [{"text":"keep costs to a minimum","meaningZh":"把成本降到最低"}]

definitionEn: a government department headed by a minister, or the work of religious ministers
usageExplanationZh: 常見 the Ministry of Education，也可指宗教上的牧靈、傳道事務。
exampleEn: The Ministry of Health issued new guidelines on food safety.
exampleZh: 衛生部發布了新的食品安全指導方針。

definitionEn: a smaller group within a larger population, especially one that differs in race, religion, or ethnicity
usageExplanationZh: 常見 an ethnic minority，強調在人口組成中占較小比例且具特定文化或背景的群體。
exampleEn: The government introduced policies to protect the rights of ethnic minorities.
exampleZh: 政府推出了保護少數族群權利的政策。

definitionEn: the smaller part of a group or total, especially in a vote or opinion
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a minority of，與 majority（多數）相對，指較小的比例或部分。
exampleEn: Only a minority of employees supported the new policy.
exampleZh: 只有少數員工支持這項新政策。

definitionEn: indicating subtraction, or being on the negative side of zero
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a minus sign、minus five degrees，數學或溫度語境中表示低於零或需扣除的數值。
exampleEn: The temperature dropped to minus ten degrees overnight.
exampleZh: 氣溫在一夜之間降到了零下十度。

definitionEn: extremely small
usageExplanationZh: 口語常見，強調數量或尺寸小到近乎可忽略，語氣比 tiny 更誇張。
exampleEn: The company's profit margin is minuscule compared to its competitors.
exampleZh: 這家公司的利潤率相較於競爭對手極為微小。

definitionEn: an extraordinary and welcome event that seems impossible to explain by natural or scientific laws
usageExplanationZh: 常見 by a miracle、a miracle cure，可指宗教意義上的神蹟，也可泛指令人驚喜的意外好結果。
exampleEn: It was a miracle that no one was hurt in the accident.
exampleZh: 這場意外中沒有人受傷，簡直是奇蹟。

definitionEn: remarkable or wonderful in a way that seems beyond ordinary explanation
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a miraculous recovery，強調結果好到令人難以置信，帶有驚嘆語氣。
exampleEn: Doctors called her recovery from the illness nothing short of miraculous.
exampleZh: 醫生稱她從這場疾病中康復簡直是奇蹟。

definitionEn: an area of deep mud, or a difficult situation that is hard to escape from
usageExplanationZh: 常見 be mired in（陷入……的困境），比喻性地指陷入難以脫身的複雜狀況。
exampleEn: The peace talks became mired in political disputes.
exampleZh: 這場和平談判陷入了政治爭端的泥沼。

definitionEn: to cause someone or something to become stuck in mud or a difficult situation
definitionZh: 使陷入泥沼；使陷入困境
usageExplanationZh: 常見被動語態 be mired in，強調受困於複雜、難以脫身的狀況。
exampleEn: The project was mired in delays and budget problems.
exampleZh: 這項計畫深陷延誤與預算問題的困境。

definitionEn: a person who dislikes people in general and avoids their company
usageExplanationZh: 正式或文學用語，強調對人類整體抱持負面態度，而非針對特定個人。
exampleEn: The old man had become something of a misanthrope after years of disappointment.
exampleZh: 多年的失望讓這位老人變得有些厭世。

definitionEn: causing trouble or annoyance in a playful, often not seriously harmful way
usageExplanationZh: 常形容兒童或動物，語氣較輕鬆，強調頑皮而非真正的惡意破壞。
exampleEn: The mischievous puppy chewed up her favorite shoes.
exampleZh: 這隻淘氣的小狗把她最喜歡的鞋子咬爛了。

definitionEn: very unhappy or uncomfortable
definitionZh: 悲慘的；痛苦的；很不舒服的
usageExplanationZh: 常見 feel miserable，也可修飾天氣、失敗等，如 miserable weather，表示令人不快的狀況。
exampleEn: He felt miserable after losing his job.
exampleZh: 他失業後感到十分痛苦。

definitionEn: a state of great unhappiness, suffering, or discomfort
usageExplanationZh: 常見 live in misery，強調長期或深刻的不幸與苦難狀態。
exampleEn: The war brought years of misery to the region.
exampleZh: 這場戰爭為這個地區帶來了多年的苦難。

definitionEn: a weapon that is propelled through the air toward a target, often carrying an explosive
usageExplanationZh: 軍事用語，常見 a guided missile，泛指以推進方式射向目標的武器。
exampleEn: The country tested a new long-range missile.
exampleZh: 這個國家試射了一枚新型長程導彈。

definitionEn: a thin cloud of tiny water droplets near the ground, similar to but lighter than fog
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a light mist，比 fog（濃霧）稀薄，常見於清晨或潮濕環境。
exampleEn: A light mist covered the valley in the early morning.
exampleZh: 清晨，薄霧籠罩著這片山谷。

definitionEn: a cell phone (British usage), or a hanging sculpture with delicately balanced parts that move in air currents
definitionZh: （英式用語）手機；（藝術）動態懸掛雕塑
usageExplanationZh: 英式英語中 mobile 作名詞可直接指「手機」（美式多用 cell phone）；也可指懸吊於空中、隨氣流擺動的藝術裝置。
exampleEn: She left her mobile at home and had to borrow a phone.
exampleZh: 她把手機忘在家裡了，只好跟別人借電話用。
collocations: [{"text":"a mobile phone","meaningZh":"手機；mobile 的完整說法"}]

definitionEn: the ability to move or be moved freely and easily
usageExplanationZh: 常見 social mobility（社會流動性）、limited mobility（行動不便），涵蓋實體移動與社會階層流動兩種意涵。
exampleEn: The injury severely limited her mobility for several months.
exampleZh: 這次受傷嚴重限制了她好幾個月的行動能力。

definitionEn: to organize and prepare people or resources for action, especially in an emergency or for war
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mobilize troops／resources，強調有組織地集結人力或資源以應對特定需求。
exampleEn: The government mobilized thousands of volunteers to help with the flood relief.
exampleZh: 政府動員了數千名志工協助這次水災救援。

definitionEn: a particular way or manner in which something is done, or a setting on a device
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a mode of transport（交通方式）、silent mode（靜音模式），涵蓋抽象方式與具體設定兩種用法。
exampleEn: Cycling is her preferred mode of transport to work.
exampleZh: 騎腳踏車是她上班時偏好的交通方式。

definitionEn: a device that connects a computer to the internet via a telephone or cable line
usageExplanationZh: 科技用語，常見 a broadband modem，指用於連接網路的通訊設備。
exampleEn: He had to restart the modem to fix the internet connection.
exampleZh: 他必須重新啟動數據機才能修復網路連線。

definitionEn: not boastful about one's own abilities or achievements
usageExplanationZh: 常形容人的態度，強調不誇耀自己的成就，與 arrogant 相對。
exampleEn: Despite her success, she remained modest about her achievements.
exampleZh: 儘管她很成功，她對自己的成就依然保持謙虛。
collocations: [{"text":"modest about one's achievements","meaningZh":"對自己的成就保持謙虛"}]

definitionEn: moderate in size, amount, or degree; not excessive
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a modest increase／income，強調數量或程度中等，不誇張也不奢華。
exampleEn: The company reported a modest increase in profits this quarter.
exampleZh: 這家公司本季的利潤有適度的成長。

definitionEn: to change something slightly, especially to improve it or make it more suitable
usageExplanationZh: 常見 modify a plan／design，強調對既有事物做局部調整，而非全面改變。
exampleEn: Engineers modified the design to reduce fuel consumption.
exampleZh: 工程師修改了這項設計，以降低燃料消耗。

definitionEn: slightly wet; containing a small amount of water or liquid
usageExplanationZh: 常見 moist soil／cake，強調適度的濕度，通常帶正面或中性語氣（如濕潤的蛋糕）。
exampleEn: Keep the soil moist but not waterlogged.
exampleZh: 保持土壤濕潤，但不要積水。
collocations: [{"text":"keep the soil moist","meaningZh":"保持土壤濕潤"}]

definitionEn: small amounts of water present in the air, on a surface, or in a substance
usageExplanationZh: 常見 moisture in the air，泛指存在於空氣、物質表面或內部的少量水分。
exampleEn: The dehumidifier removes excess moisture from the air.
exampleZh: 除濕機能去除空氣中多餘的濕氣。

definitionEn: relating to or consisting of molecules
usageExplanationZh: 科學用語，常見 molecular structure／biology，涉及物質最基本結構單位的相關研究。
exampleEn: Molecular biology has revolutionized our understanding of genetics.
exampleZh: 分子生物學徹底改變了我們對遺傳學的理解。

definitionEn: the smallest unit of a substance that has all the properties of that substance, made up of atoms
usageExplanationZh: 化學用語，指由原子組成、保有該物質性質的最小單位。
exampleEn: Water molecules consist of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
exampleZh: 水分子由兩個氫原子和一個氧原子組成。

definitionEn: to sexually harass or assault someone, especially a child
usageExplanationZh: 法律及新聞用語，語氣嚴肅，特指帶有性侵害或不當接觸性質的行為。
exampleEn: The suspect was charged with attempting to molest a minor.
exampleZh: 這名嫌疑人被控企圖猥褻未成年人。
collocations: [{"text":"sexually molest a child","meaningZh":"對兒童實施性侵害"}]

definitionEn: to make someone less angry or upset, often by making concessions
usageExplanationZh: 正式用語，常見 mollify an angry customer，強調透過讓步或安撫化解對方的不滿情緒。
exampleEn: The manager tried to mollify the angry customer with a refund.
exampleZh: 經理試圖用退款來安撫這位憤怒的顧客。
collocations: [{"text":"mollify an angry customer","meaningZh":"安撫憤怒的顧客"}]

definitionEn: the force or speed that keeps something moving forward, or the driving force behind progress
usageExplanationZh: 可指物理學上的動量，也可比喻性地形容計畫或運動不斷推進的力量，如 gain momentum。
exampleEn: The campaign gained momentum after receiving media attention.
exampleZh: 這場運動在受到媒體關注後聲勢大增。

definitionEn: a king, queen, or other ruler of a country who inherits the position
usageExplanationZh: 正式用語，強調透過世襲繼承王位的統治者，區別於民選領導人。
exampleEn: The monarch opened the new session of parliament.
exampleZh: 這位君主為國會的新會期揭幕。

definitionEn: a system of government in which a country is ruled by a king or queen
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a constitutional monarchy（君主立憲制），指以世襲君主為國家元首的政治體制。
exampleEn: The country has been a constitutional monarchy since the early twentieth century.
exampleZh: 自二十世紀初以來，這個國家一直實行君主立憲制。

definitionEn: a building where monks live together as a religious community
usageExplanationZh: 宗教用語，特指男性僧侶集體居住修行的場所，女性則多用 convent。
exampleEn: The monks have lived in this monastery for over five hundred years.
exampleZh: 這些僧侶已在這座修道院裡生活了超過五百年。

definitionEn: relating to money or currency
usageExplanationZh: 常見 monetary policy（貨幣政策）、monetary value，多用於經濟、財政等正式語境。
exampleEn: The central bank adjusted its monetary policy to control inflation.
exampleZh: 央行調整了貨幣政策以控制通貨膨脹。

definitionEn: extremely large, powerful, and difficult to change, often seen as a single unified whole
definitionZh: 巨大且僵化的；整體劃一的
usageExplanationZh: 常帶負面意涵，形容組織或體制龐大、缺乏彈性，如 a monolithic bureaucracy。
exampleEn: Critics described the agency as a monolithic bureaucracy resistant to reform。
exampleZh: 批評者形容這個機構是個龐大僵化、抗拒改革的官僚體系。
collocations: [{"text":"a monolithic organization","meaningZh":"龐大且僵化的組織"}]

definitionEn: exclusive control over a market or resource by a single company or entity
usageExplanationZh: 經濟用語，常見 have a monopoly on／over，強調單一實體完全掌控某市場或資源。
exampleEn: The company once had a monopoly on telephone services in the country.
exampleZh: 這家公司曾一度壟斷了該國的電話服務。

definitionEn: tediously repetitive and lacking variety
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 job、voice、routine 等，強調缺乏變化而令人感到枯燥。
exampleEn: Working on the assembly line can be quite monotonous.
exampleZh: 在生產線上工作可能相當單調乏味。

definitionEn: an imaginary frightening creature, or a cruel and inhuman person
usageExplanationZh: 可指虛構的可怕生物，也可比喻性地形容行為極端殘忍的人。
exampleEn: The children were scared of the monster in the storybook.
exampleZh: 孩子們害怕故事書裡的怪物。

definitionEn: extremely large, or shockingly wrong and cruel
usageExplanationZh: 可單純形容尺寸極大，也可帶強烈道德譴責意味，如 a monstrous crime。
exampleEn: The court described the attack as a monstrous crime against humanity.
exampleZh: 法院將這次攻擊描述為一樁令人髮指的反人類罪行。

definitionEn: a structure built to honor and remember a person, event, or historical site
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a national monument，也可比喻性地指具重大意義的成就或作品。
exampleEn: The statue serves as a monument to the fallen soldiers.
exampleZh: 這座雕像作為紀念陣亡士兵的紀念碑。
collocations: [{"text":"a monument to the fallen","meaningZh":"紀念陣亡者的紀念碑"}]

definitionEn: extremely great in size, extent, or significance
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 achievement、mistake、task 等，語氣強烈，強調規模或重要性非同小可。
exampleEn: Completing the marathon was a monumental achievement for him.
exampleZh: 完成這場馬拉松對他來說是一項意義重大的成就。

definitionEn: the way someone feels at a particular time, or the general atmosphere of a place or situation
usageExplanationZh: 常見 in a good／bad mood、set the mood，可指個人情緒，也可指場所或情境營造的氣氛。
exampleEn: Soft lighting helped set a relaxing mood for the dinner party.
exampleZh: 柔和的燈光為這場晚宴營造了輕鬆的氛圍。

definitionEn: tending to change moods often and unpredictably, especially becoming irritable or sad
usageExplanationZh: 常形容青少年或性格敏感的人，強調情緒起伏大且不易預測。
exampleEn: Teenagers can be moody as their hormones fluctuate.
exampleZh: 青少年因荷爾蒙變化，情緒可能容易起伏不定。
collocations: [{"text":"a moody teenager","meaningZh":"喜怒無常的青少年"}]

definitionEn: the level of confidence, enthusiasm, and discipline within a group
usageExplanationZh: 常見 boost morale、low morale，多用於團隊、軍隊或員工的集體心理狀態。
exampleEn: The team's morale improved after their unexpected win.
exampleZh: 這支隊伍在意外獲勝後，士氣大振。

definitionEn: principles concerning the distinction between right and wrong behavior
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a sense of morality、questions of morality，涉及倫理判斷與行為準則的抽象概念。
exampleEn: The novel raises difficult questions about morality and justice.
exampleZh: 這部小說提出了關於道德與正義的艱難問題。

definitionEn: having an unusual and unhealthy interest in death or unpleasant subjects
definitionZh: 病態的；對死亡等陰暗事物過度著迷的
usageExplanationZh: 常見 morbid curiosity，形容對死亡、疾病等令人不安主題抱持異常興趣。
exampleEn: He has a morbid fascination with true crime stories.
exampleZh: 他對真實犯罪故事有一種病態的著迷。
collocations: [{"text":"a morbid fascination with death","meaningZh":"對死亡的病態迷戀"}]

definitionEn: the state of being subject to death, or the rate of death within a population
usageExplanationZh: 常見 infant mortality rate（嬰兒死亡率），也可用於哲學語境探討人終將一死的本質。
exampleEn: The country has successfully reduced its infant mortality rate over the past decade.
exampleZh: 這個國家在過去十年成功降低了嬰兒死亡率。

definitionEn: a loan used to buy property, with the property itself serving as security for the loan
usageExplanationZh: 金融用語，常見 pay off a mortgage、take out a mortgage，指以不動產作為擔保的貸款。
exampleEn: They took out a thirty-year mortgage to buy their first home.
exampleZh: 他們申請了三十年期的房貸來購買第一間房子。

definitionEn: relating to death, burial, or funerals
usageExplanationZh: 正式或委婉用語，常見 mortuary rites，多用於描述與埋葬、悼念儀式相關的事物。
exampleEn: The tribe practiced elaborate mortuary rites for its chieftains.
exampleZh: 這個部落為其首領舉行了精緻繁複的喪葬儀式。

definitionEn: a picture or pattern made by arranging small pieces of colored stone, glass, or tile
usageExplanationZh: 藝術用語，也可比喻性地形容由多樣元素組成的整體，如 a mosaic of cultures。
exampleEn: The ancient floor featured an intricate mosaic of colored tiles.
exampleZh: 這座古老的地板飾有一幅精緻的彩色瓷磚鑲嵌畫。

definitionEn: a building used by Muslims for worship
usageExplanationZh: 宗教建築詞彙，指伊斯蘭教徒進行禮拜的場所。
exampleEn: Thousands gathered at the mosque for Friday prayers.
exampleZh: 數千人聚集在清真寺參加週五的禮拜。
collocations: [{"text":"attend a mosque","meaningZh":"到清真寺參加宗教活動"}]

definitionEn: a small flying insect that bites and sucks blood, and can spread diseases
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mosquito bite、mosquito net，也常出現在瘧疾等疾病傳播的相關語境。
exampleEn: Mosquitoes can transmit diseases like malaria and dengue fever.
exampleZh: 蚊子會傳播瘧疾和登革熱等疾病。

definitionEn: a roadside hotel designed for travelers, typically with parking near the rooms
usageExplanationZh: 常見於公路旅行語境，強調便於停車、供旅客短暫過夜的住宿設施。
exampleEn: They stopped at a cheap motel along the highway for the night.
exampleZh: 他們在高速公路旁的一家便宜汽車旅館過夜。

definitionEn: a recurring theme, image, or idea in a work of art, literature, or music
definitionZh: 主題；主旋律；反覆出現的元素
usageExplanationZh: 常見於藝術與文學分析，指作品中重複出現、具象徵意義的元素或想法。
exampleEn: The theme of loss is a recurring motif throughout the novel.
exampleZh: 失落這個主題在這部小說中反覆出現。
collocations: [{"text":"a recurring motif","meaningZh":"反覆出現的主題元素"}]

definitionEn: the act or process of moving, or a change in position
usageExplanationZh: 物理或日常用語，如 in motion（運轉中），泛指物體位置的變化。
exampleEn: The gears kept the machine in constant motion.
exampleZh: 這些齒輪讓機器持續運轉。

definitionEn: a formal proposal put forward for discussion and a vote, especially at a meeting
usageExplanationZh: 正式會議用語，常見 propose a motion、pass a motion，指提交表決的正式建議。
exampleEn: The committee voted to pass the motion to increase funding.
exampleZh: 委員會投票通過了增加經費的提案。

definitionEn: to give someone a reason or incentive to do something
usageExplanationZh: 常見 motivate employees／students，強調提供動機或誘因使人採取行動。
exampleEn: A good manager knows how to motivate the team during difficult times.
exampleZh: 優秀的經理知道如何在困難時期激勵團隊。
collocations: [{"text":"motivate someone to learn","meaningZh":"激勵某人學習"}]

definitionEn: the reason or driving force behind a person's actions; enthusiasm for doing something
usageExplanationZh: 常見 lack motivation、a source of motivation，強調驅使行為的內在原因或熱情。
exampleEn: Lack of motivation made it hard for him to finish the project.
exampleZh: 缺乏動力讓他很難完成這個專案。

definitionEn: causing or able to cause motion or action
usageExplanationZh: 常見 motive force／power，指驅使物體運動或引發行動的力量，屬較正式或技術性用法。
exampleEn: Steam provided the motive power for early locomotives.
exampleZh: 蒸汽為早期的火車頭提供了推動的動力。

definitionEn: a fuzzy growth of fungus that develops on damp or decaying substances
usageExplanationZh: 常見 bread mould，指食物或潮濕環境中生長的真菌，與英式拼法一致（美式為 mold）。
exampleEn: Mould had started to grow on the old bread in the fridge.
exampleZh: 冰箱裡那塊舊麵包已經開始長黴了。

definitionEn: to shape a soft material into a particular form
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mould something into a shape，可指實際塑形，也可比喻性地形容塑造性格或觀念。
exampleEn: The clay was moulded into the shape of a vase.
exampleZh: 這塊黏土被塑成了花瓶的形狀。

definitionEn: having many mountains, or resembling a mountain in size
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mountainous terrain／region，也可誇張地形容數量或規模巨大，如 a mountainous task。
exampleEn: The northern part of the country is largely mountainous.
exampleZh: 該國北部大多是多山地形。

definitionEn: being nothing more than what is specified; used to emphasize how small or insignificant something is
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a mere child、the mere thought of，用來強調事物微小或程度輕微，帶強調語氣。
exampleEn: The mere thought of public speaking made him nervous.
exampleZh: 光是想到要公開演講，就讓他緊張了起來。

definitionEn: relating to the broad, flat teeth at the back of the mouth used for grinding food
usageExplanationZh: 牙科用語，常見 a molar tooth，指位於口腔後方、用於磨碎食物的寬平牙齒。
exampleEn: The dentist noticed a small cavity in one of her molar teeth.
exampleZh: 牙醫發現她的一顆臼齒上有個小蛀洞。

definitionEn: one of the broad, flat teeth at the back of the mouth used for grinding food
usageExplanationZh: 常見於牙科語境，指口腔後方負責咀嚼磨碎食物的牙齒。
exampleEn: Wisdom teeth are the last molars to develop.
exampleZh: 智齒是最後長出的臼齒。

definitionEn: a fuzzy growth of fungus that develops on damp or decaying substances
usageExplanationZh: 美式拼法（英式為 mould），常見 bread mold，指食物或潮濕表面滋生的真菌。
exampleEn: Mold began to grow on the bread left out overnight.
exampleZh: 麵包放了一整晚後開始長黴。

definitionEn: a hollow container used to give shape to a liquid or soft substance as it hardens
usageExplanationZh: 常見 pour into a mold，用於製作特定形狀的物品，如蠟燭、金屬鑄件等。
exampleEn: The chocolate was poured into a mold shaped like a heart.
exampleZh: 巧克力被倒進一個心形的模子裡。

definitionEn: the ability to move spontaneously
usageExplanationZh: 科學用語，常見 sperm motility，指細胞或微生物自行移動的能力。
exampleEn: Low sperm motility can affect a couple's fertility.
exampleZh: 精子活動力低可能影響夫妻的生育能力。

definitionEn: to feel and show deep sadness, especially over someone's death
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mourn for／over someone，也可比喻性地用於失去的事物，如 mourn the loss of。
exampleEn: The whole nation mourned the death of the beloved leader.
exampleZh: 全國人民都為這位深受愛戴的領袖辭世而哀悼。
collocations: [{"text":"mourn the loss of","meaningZh":"哀悼失去的人或事物"}]

definitionEn: expressing or feeling deep sadness or grief
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 song、expression、look 等，語氣文學化，強調流露出的哀愁。
exampleEn: The violin played a mournful melody at the funeral.
exampleZh: 葬禮上，小提琴演奏了一首悲傷的旋律。

definitionEn: to mix things up in a confused or disorganized way, or to think or act in a confused manner
usageExplanationZh: 常見 muddle through（勉強應付過去）、muddled thinking，強調缺乏條理、思緒不清。
exampleEn: He muddled the dates and arrived a day early.
exampleZh: 他把日期搞混了，提早一天就到了。

definitionEn: to deaden or soften a sound, especially by covering or wrapping something
usageExplanationZh: 常見 muffle a sound／cry，強調透過覆蓋或包裹使聲音變得模糊不清或降低音量。
exampleEn: She muffled her sobs with a pillow so no one would hear.
exampleZh: 她用枕頭悶住自己的啜泣聲，不讓任何人聽到。

definitionEn: consisting of more than one part, element, or instance
usageExplanationZh: 常見 multiple choice、multiple injuries，強調數量不只一個，常用於正式或技術性描述。
exampleEn: The accident resulted in multiple injuries among the passengers.
exampleZh: 這起意外造成乘客多處受傷。

definitionEn: a large number or variety of something
usageExplanationZh: 正式用語，常見 a multiplicity of，強調種類或數量繁多，語氣比 variety 更正式。
exampleEn: The report highlights a multiplicity of factors contributing to the decline.
exampleZh: 這份報告強調了導致這次衰退的多重因素。

definitionEn: to increase greatly in number or amount, or to calculate by repeated addition
usageExplanationZh: 常見 multiply rapidly，也可作數學用語，如 multiply two numbers together。
exampleEn: Rabbits are known to multiply quickly if left unchecked.
exampleZh: 兔子若不加以控制，繁殖速度會非常快。

definitionEn: lacking excitement or significance; ordinary and dull
usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 task、life、routine 等，強調日常生活中缺乏新意或刺激的一面。
exampleEn: Most of her job involves mundane tasks like filing paperwork.
exampleZh: 她的工作大多是歸檔文件之類的平凡瑣事。

definitionEn: relating to the local government of a town or city
usageExplanationZh: 常見 municipal government／services，指與城市或地方政府相關的行政事務。
exampleEn: The municipal government announced new recycling regulations.
exampleZh: 市政府宣布了新的資源回收規定。

definitionEn: a town, city, or district that has its own local government
usageExplanationZh: 常見於行政或法律語境，指擁有自我管理權的城鎮或行政區域。
exampleEn: Each municipality is responsible for maintaining its own roads.
exampleZh: 每個自治市都負責維護自己轄區內的道路。

definitionEn: military supplies, especially ammunition and explosives
usageExplanationZh: 常用複數 munitions，泛指軍事裝備與彈藥物資，多見於戰爭或國防語境。
exampleEn: The factory was converted to produce munitions during the war.
exampleZh: 這家工廠在戰爭期間被改為生產軍需品。

definitionEn: dark, cloudy, or difficult to see through, especially liquid; unclear or morally questionable
usageExplanationZh: 可形容水或天色昏暗渾濁，也可比喻性地形容情況或動機不清不楚，如 murky details。
exampleEn: The murky water made it impossible to see the bottom of the pond.
exampleZh: 渾濁的池水讓人完全看不到池底。

definitionEn: to say something in a soft, quiet, and often unclear voice
usageExplanationZh: 常見 murmur something to oneself，強調聲音輕柔、不易聽清，也可指低聲抱怨。
exampleEn: She murmured a few words of comfort to the crying child.
exampleZh: 她低聲對哭泣的孩子說了幾句安慰的話。

definitionEn: a body tissue that can contract to produce movement, or the strength this provides
usageExplanationZh: 常見 build muscle、flex one's muscles，也可比喻性地指影響力或強制力，如 political muscle。
exampleEn: Regular weightlifting helps build muscle over time.
exampleZh: 長期規律地舉重有助於增長肌肉。

definitionEn: a fungus with a stem and a cap, some of which are edible
usageExplanationZh: 常見於食物語境，如 fried mushrooms，也涵蓋各種可食或不可食的傘狀真菌。
exampleEn: She added sliced mushrooms to the pasta sauce.
exampleZh: 她在義大利麵醬裡加了切片蘑菇。

definitionEn: a cloud of dust and debris shaped like a mushroom, rising into the sky after an explosion
definitionZh: 蕈狀雲（爆炸後形成的雲狀煙塵）
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a mushroom cloud，特指核爆或大型爆炸後升起、外形似蘑菇的煙塵雲。
exampleEn: Witnesses described seeing a massive mushroom cloud after the blast.
exampleZh: 目擊者描述在爆炸後看見一朵巨大的蕈狀雲。

definitionEn: to gather together courage, strength, or support, or to assemble troops for duty
usageExplanationZh: 常見 muster the courage to，也可指軍事上的召集，如 muster troops。
exampleEn: She had to muster all her courage to speak in front of the crowd。
exampleZh: 她必須鼓起全部的勇氣才能在群眾面前發言。

definitionEn: a formal gathering, especially of military personnel
usageExplanationZh: 軍事用語，常見 pass muster（達到標準、通過檢驗），源自軍隊點名檢閱的傳統。
exampleEn: His work didn't pass muster with the strict new supervisor.
exampleZh: 他的工作在這位嚴格的新主管眼中並不合格。

definitionEn: having a stale, unpleasant smell, often from dampness or age
usageExplanationZh: 常形容 an old room／book 等長期潮濕封閉所產生的氣味，也可比喻過時陳舊。
exampleEn: The old basement had a musty smell from years of dampness.
exampleZh: 這間老舊的地下室因多年潮濕而散發著霉味。

definitionEn: a change in the genetic structure of an organism, or a significant alteration in form
usageExplanationZh: 生物學用語，常見 a genetic mutation，也可泛指形式或性質上的顯著改變。
exampleEn: A random mutation gave the bacteria resistance to the antibiotic.
exampleZh: 一次隨機的突變讓這種細菌對這種抗生素產生了抗藥性。

definitionEn: silent, or unable or unwilling to speak
usageExplanationZh: 常見 remain mute，可指生理上無法言語，也可指選擇保持沉默。
exampleEn: He remained mute during the entire interrogation.
exampleZh: 他在整場審訊過程中始終保持沉默。

definitionEn: a device used to soften or muffle the sound of a musical instrument
usageExplanationZh: 音樂用語，常見於銅管或弦樂器演奏，用來降低或改變樂器音色。
exampleEn: The trumpeter inserted a mute to soften the tone.
exampleZh: 小號手裝上弱音器來柔化音色。

definitionEn: a low, indistinct sound made without clearly forming words, often while complaining
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a mutter of complaint，指低沉含糊、通常帶抱怨語氣的聲音。
exampleEn: A mutter of discontent spread through the crowd.
exampleZh: 一陣不滿的低語聲在人群中蔓延開來。

definitionEn: shared or felt equally by two or more people
usageExplanationZh: 常見 mutual respect／agreement，強調雙方共同擁有或共同感受的關係。
exampleEn: Their business partnership was built on mutual trust and respect.
exampleZh: 他們的事業夥伴關係建立在相互信任與尊重之上。

definitionEn: difficult to understand or explain; strange and puzzling
usageExplanationZh: 常見 a mysterious disappearance，強調事物或情況缺乏明確解釋，引發好奇或不安。
exampleEn: The mysterious disappearance of the ship has never been explained.
exampleZh: 這艘船神祕失蹤的原因至今未能查明。
